literally-even.name: Literally Even
literally-even.intro: Small practices and reflections for finding your next manageable step. Start with one moment, then explore deeper at your own pace.
features: Explore the bundled practices and reflection tools.
Use plans and prompts to turn an idea into a small next step.
Return to your saved work without starting over.
demo: Open Begin a small step and choose a prompt that fits your moment.
Try one practice. Write a short reflection in the relevant tool if you want to keep it.
Explore the other sections when you are ready; you do not need to complete them all.
setup: Choose one practice to try first.
Find the saved-work and backup controls before keeping important notes.
Decide when a short reflection would fit your day.
literally-even.boundary: This Android prototype includes local tools and bundled material. It does not provide professional care or guarantee that every website feature works offline.
literally-even.privacy: Local work stays in this app unless you deliberately share or export it. No account or permission is required for this guide.

tea.name: Being Tea
tea.intro: A brewing companion for keeping track of an infusion, noticing what you taste, and learning what you enjoy.
features: Choose a tea family and explore the supported brewing methods.
Start, pause and resume an infusion timer.
Save, edit and search tasting notes, with backup tools for your journal.
demo: Choose a tea family you already have, then read its method and starting-point guidance.
Start a session; pause or adjust your timing as you explore the timer.
After brewing, save what you noticed in a tasting note. This example does not start a timer or save a note.
setup: Choose your usual tea family and review the suggested method.
Try the timer while the app is open before relying on it.
Locate journal export/import and make a backup after your first tasting.
tea.boundary: Brewing guidance uses the approved library. Background and lock-screen timer notifications still need device testing; keep the timer visible when timing matters.
tea.privacy: The tasting journal is local. Sharing or importing is your choice; cloud sync is not set up by this guide.

smile.name: Smile To Your Body
smile.intro: Build a personal practice from the approved session library, with room to choose what fits you today.
features: Explore approved practices and compose a session.
Review the selected activities before beginning.
Return to the session tools as your needs change.
demo: Open the practice composer and review the available choices.
Choose a small session using the existing instructions.
Review it before you begin. This walkthrough does not prescribe a routine or start a session.
setup: Read the guidance for any practice you choose.
Build one short session you can review comfortably.
Locate the session and saved-work controls.
smile.boundary: This prototype uses approved content only. It does not assess your body or create clinical recommendations.
smile.privacy: No body measurements or health permissions are required for the walkthrough. Use only the information you want to keep in the app.

aware.name: Aware Of My Food
aware.intro: A private purchase-reflection journal. Consider health, carbon and price without pretending every answer is known.
features: Record purchase context, evidence, unknowns and a chosen next step.
Use the editorial labels Verified, Reported, Inferred and Unknown.
Search reflections and use local export/import tools.
demo: Choose New reflection and name a purchase you want to think about.
Write what you can support; leave uncertain information Unknown.
Choose your balance and next step, then save. The example here creates no entry.
setup: Read How the journal works and the privacy explanation.
Make one reflection from a real choice, without guessing missing evidence.
Export a backup after saving information you want to keep.
aware.boundary: There is no product lookup, barcode scoring, food ranking or invented environmental/health score. Evidence labels are editorial, not regulatory classifications.
aware.privacy: Reflections stay on this device unless you export them. No account, camera or product database is needed.

noo.name: Noo You
noo.intro: A private observation log built around the approved Noo missions. Notice, record and revisit your own experience.
features: Explore the bundled, approved missions.
Save observations and use the existing filters to revisit them.
Use backup tools to keep a copy of your local log.
demo: Review the adult-use disclosure in the app before proceeding.
Choose an available mission and read its actual instructions.
Record what you noticed in your own words. This tour does not accept the disclosure or add an observation.
setup: Review the app’s disclosure yourself.
Choose one approved mission to explore.
Locate the observation filters and backup controls.
noo.boundary: Only the approved mission set is included. This is an observation prototype, not a clinical assessment, sensor system or treatment tool.
noo.privacy: The walkthrough does not request sensor access or upload observations. Your consent choices remain yours.

wonder.name: Wonder Notes
wonder.intro: Organize ideas into projects, connect what you learn, and prepare useful context for your AI workflows without automatically sending private notes anywhere.
features: Create projects and notes; add tags, sources and connections. Pin, archive, restore and move notes.
Search locally and explore curated roulette using interests and explicit relevance feedback.
Prepare context packets, save pasted replies, and share or import workspace backups.
demo: Create a project such as Garden ideas, then add a note with a source link.
Connect it to another note or pin it for easy return.
Try Roulette, mark relevance, then use Library or Assist to prepare a context packet. Nothing is created or sent by this tour.
setup: Create your first project and note.
Add a few interests in Library.
Find workspace backup and export a file after saving useful work.
Review a context packet before sharing it with any AI tool.
wonder.boundary: Roulette currently uses a labeled bundled catalog, not live web discovery. AI context sharing is manual; no model receives your notes automatically.
wonder.privacy: Your workspace is local. Import validates a backup; Replace overwrites the current workspace, while Merge follows the documented conflict rules.

brick.name: Brick by Brick
brick.intro: Turn a broad idea into an organized local project and a clearer next step, one piece at a time.
features: Use the local project and planning tools.
Review and revise your work as a project develops.
Prepare exports for use outside this app.
demo: Create a project around one outcome you care about.
Use the planning tools to identify a manageable next step.
Review the project and prepare an export when you want to continue elsewhere. This tour adds no project.
setup: Choose one project to organize first.
Explore the available planning fields before adding a large backlog.
Locate export controls and keep a copy of important work.
brick.boundary: The current companion is local. A real MCP connection is not active; its host and access policy still need to be chosen and implemented.
brick.privacy: An export is a deliberate action. The guide does not connect tools, grant remote access or send your project to an AI service.

communication.name: Life Giving Communication
communication.intro: Prepare for a conversation using the approved communication library, then keep a plan that reflects what you want to say.
features: Explore the canonical library of 40 scripts.
Use Prepare a conversation to work on a plan.
Review saved plans and the explicitly labeled walkthrough fixture.
demo: Choose a situation from the library and read the full script.
Open Prepare a conversation and adapt a plan to your own situation.
Review before saving or using it. The fixture is an example, not your private history.
setup: Browse one script that fits a conversation you want to prepare for.
Create your first private plan when you are ready.
Find the saved-plan tools and review what a fixture contains before saving it.
communication.boundary: This app provides local preparation tools and approved scripts. It does not connect you to a live coach or automatically deliver messages.
communication.privacy: The walkthrough sends no message and creates no plan. Keep only the personal details you need.

personas.name: Personas
personas.intro: A mobile entrance to your real MyPersonas owner workspace: select a persona, review work and stay in control of what happens next.
features: Open the actual owner website and switch between the personas available to your account.
Access the workspace’s available drafts, approvals, research and inbox tools.
Use account preferences and the website controls for authorized services.
demo: Sign in with your own MyPersonas account when the website asks.
Select the intended persona before reviewing a draft or workspace item.
Review the destination and content before any publishing action. This guide signs in to nothing and publishes nothing.
setup: Have your real account credentials and any MFA method ready.
Confirm which persona and account you are using.
Review provider connections and permissions in the owner website before relying on them.
personas.boundary: The app needs internet and the actual service. Available features depend on your account and connected providers. A saved account row is not proof that a provider is authorized.
personas.privacy: Authentication happens through the real service. Do not paste passwords into notes or drafts. The guide requests no credentials.

terraseeds.name: Terraseeds
terraseeds.intro: Keep a planter’s seed journal and explore seed cards, starting with a useful record of what you actually have.
features: Record and revisit seeds using the existing local collection tools.
Open a seed’s detail and inspect its card information.
Share a JSON backup or choose a backup file for validated merge/replace import.
demo: Add a seed you own, using information you can verify.
Open its detail to review your record; expand Card experiment if you want to inspect the proposed game layer.
Export a backup after adding records. This example creates no seed or trade.
setup: Choose one seed packet to record first.
Review the available fields and leave unknown information unspecified.
Locate backup tools and save a copy of your collection.
terraseeds.boundary: Real seed trading and accounts are not connected. Trading-card game mechanics remain proposed; the Card experiment is not a finished game.
terraseeds.privacy: Your collection starts locally. The guide does not publish it, match traders or arrange exchanges. Replace import overwrites the current local collection.

aliaspaces.name: AliaSpaces
aliaspaces.intro: Explore AliaSpaces through three distinct modes while keeping the relationship to your MyPersonas account clear.
features: Website opens the actual AliaSpaces website and shared account system.
Social opens the first-party social client; sign-in and review gates still apply.
Local opens a separate demonstration; it does not write to the website database.
demo: Start in Website to see the real service, or choose Local to inspect the demonstration.
Check the mode label before entering information or expecting shared-account behavior.
Use Social only with the understanding that a verified session and review rules are required. This guide creates no account or post.
setup: Choose the mode appropriate to what you want to test.
Have your shared MyPersonas credentials and MFA available for real sign-in.
Confirm the selected account and mode before using online features.
aliaspaces.boundary: Website, Social and Local are different experiences. Local demo records are not online posts. Production authorization, moderation and multi-account privacy still need release verification.
aliaspaces.privacy: Only enter credentials into the real sign-in flow. This walkthrough performs no sign-in, account linking or publication.

cooked-integrated-test.name: Cooked Just Right
cooked-integrated-test.intro: Track a quick dish estimate or a weighed recipe, then explore nutrients, preparation and your own context alongside a persistent pantry.
features: Search 13,225 USDA foods and dishes; log portions, meals and dates, with detailed nutrients and personal targets.
Build weighed recipes with finished yield and selected preparation models. Record storage events, water and dated body/lab context.
Review evidence explaining nutrient retention and absorption. Export/import your local history, and keep pantry/shopping tools separate from the labeled planner demo.
demo: Search a dish, choose the closest description and set a portion before saving. Values are estimates, even when the portion is weighed.
For more detail, add measured ingredients to Recipes and enter the finished batch weight. Check preparation assumptions and missing data.
Record preparation/storage and body context when useful. No demo records are created by this guide.
setup: Try one food entry and review its source and portion.
Create a weighed recipe if you need more detailed meal estimates.
Choose personal targets only if useful; none are prescribed automatically.
Back up important records. Nutrition backups include sensitive body/lab notes.
cooked-integrated-test.boundary: Storage history does not produce a validated nutrient-decay curve. Body context does not establish a diagnosis or calculate personal absorption. Scanner, live brands and automatic health integrations are not connected.
cooked-integrated-test.privacy: Records stay in this app unless you export them. Android automatic backup is disabled for this build. The app does not recommend supplement doses.
